evals.prompt: Make the river reflect the aurora without changing my face.
evals.expected_output: Choose image-art-direction; protect the subject and compare a draft at display size.
assertions: Choose image-art-direction; protect the subject and compare a draft at display size.

evals.prompt: Submit this exact prompt to Higgsfield without revising it.
Critique my draft without generating another image.
evals.expected_output: Review only; no job, upload, upscale or publication.
assertions: Review only; no job, upload, upscale or publication.

evals.prompt: Two draft jobs cost 1.5 and 2 credits. Deliver one image for review.
evals.expected_output: One medium draft and a short credit line.
assertions: Delivers one image, without crops or comparison sheets.
Reports each actual charge and the 3.5-credit request total.
Reports remaining balance when verified; never invents it.
